verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a memory feature where 'Copilot can store specific facts users request it to remember' and use them to shape future responses/suggestions, which maps to persistent preferences (copilot-docs-32, copilot-docs-33). However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'custom instructions' settings panel comparable to competitors, nor evidence it applies uniformly across all Copilot surfaces (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.), and no independent hands-on confirmation that memory persistently shapes every response. Missing for 10: explicit custom-instructions/preferences UI documentation, cross-surface consistency evidence, independent corroboration of memory reliability.
